tick.$description: One animation frame step for steps() motion (20 fps, CRT-era feel)

decay.$description: Phosphor afterglow: how long glow lingers after hover/focus leaves

blink.$description: Half-period of the block cursor blink (classic VGA timing)

type.$description: Per character for typed-out text (boot lines, Operator speech)

decay.$description: Fast drop, long tail: phosphor fading out

steps.$description: Stepped motion. DTCG has no steps() type: the value is linear for tools that ignore extensions; platforms read the step count from $extensions.

effect.$description: CRT/phosphor effect intensities (0..1). All effects are opt-in and off under reduced motion where they animate.

glow-strength.$description: Alpha of the text glow halo

scanline-opacity.$description: Darkness of every second pixel row

flicker.$description: Brightness wobble amplitude. Kept well under any flash threshold; off with reduced motion

rain-density.$description: Digital rain: fraction of columns active
